title: GST standard rate 8% to 9% on 1 January 2024
summary: GST Act s 16 and the IRAS rate page move the standard rate from 8% to 9% from 1 January 2024. Reverse charge and Overseas Vendor Registration move with the standard rate. Zero-rated, exempt, and out-of-scope treatments are unchanged.

legal_basis.title: Goods and Services Tax Act 1993
legal_basis.instrument: Goods and Services Tax Act 1993, s 16 (Rate of tax)

legal_basis.title: IRAS | Current GST rates
legal_basis.instrument: IRAS webpage: Prevailing GST rate and historical GST rates
legal_basis.pinpoint: Historical GST rates table (3% from 1 Apr 1994 ... 8% 1 Jan 2023-31 Dec 2023); 'The current GST rate in Singapore is 9%'

changes.summary: Standard-rated GST, including GST collected under reverse charge and Overseas Vendor Registration, moves from 8% to 9%.

migration_impact.summary: Invoices and GST F5 returns for supplies from 1 January 2024 use 9%. Supplies through 31 December 2023 stay at 8%.
